description: Search which brands sponsor Spanish-language podcasts or YouTube channels, filtered by brand, show, country or only ads with a promo code. Busca qué marcas patrocinan podcasts y canales en español, por marca, programa, país o con código de descuento. Returns placements from the last 30 days: brand, show, country, episode date, promo code, offer and links. Not for shows outside Spain and Latin America. Data comes from written episode descriptions, not audio. / Los datos salen de descripciones escritas, no de audio.

brand.description: Brand name, partial is fine, e.g. 'Hostinger'

country.description: Country of the show; accents optional / País del programa; tildes opcionales

show.description: Podcast or YouTube channel name, partial is fine

with_promo_code.description: Only placements that include a promo code

name: search_podcast_sponsorships
title: Buscar patrocinios en podcasts / Search podcast sponsorships
